items.quote: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam
items.claim: Young livestock must remain under the dam for seven days after being brought forth

items.quote: from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the LORD
items.claim: From the eighth day onward, livestock shall be accepted as burnt offerings to the LORD
